content_sections.heading: NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support 1 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted based on the details furnished in the application CV and documentary proof provided. The final selection will be based on the CV, application, and interview. Shortlisting of candidates (5 times the number of posts) will be done by a committee assessing the application and experience, with additional qualifying marks given for relevant experience, involvement in other projects, field works, etc., after the qualifying experience. The recruitment process is based on interviews covering topics such as knowledge about airway management and airway instruments, communication skills, photography, consent taking, data entry, operation of mobile phone, operation of Excel, Microsoft Word, etc., in computers.

Fill out the application form carefully in block letters using a blue pen on A4 size paper. Name your scanned full application PDF file according to the specified format: "candidate_name_postname_year_application" (e.g., “James_PTSIII_2026_application”). Send your complete application in PDF format via email to [email protected] by 5 pm on 15/10/2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment project title for the NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support - 1 post?
faq.answer: The project is titled “Development and Prospective Multicentric Validation of an AI-Based Model for Automated Airway Assessment and Difficult Airway Prediction”, funded by ICMR New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support - 1?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support - 1 post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support - 1 recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date for sending complete applications is up to 5:00 PM on 15/10/2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a 10th pass with 5 years experience as an OT Assistant / OT Technician / ICU Technician, or a 10th pass + Diploma in operation theatre technology / B.Sc in OT Technology, or a three-year Graduate degree in a relevant subject/field + one year experience in a relevant subject.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support - 1?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the NEIGRIHMS Project Technical Support - 1 post?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their application summary through the Google form link and email their full application in PDF format to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for Project Technical Support - 1?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs 18,000/- per month plus 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. When and where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the interview is 23/10/2026 at 10:00 AM in Room number 103, 1st Floor, OPD, Department of Anaesthesiology and Critical Care, NEIGRIHMS.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job at NEIGRIHMS?
faq.answer: No, this position is purely on a contract basis for an externally sponsored project and does not offer any claim to a regular post in NEIGRIHMS or ICMR.
